name: cccollab
description: Real-time collaboration between Claude Code sessions via channels and threaded topics

profile.title: Profile (optional)
profile.description: Selects the credentials file at ~/.config/cccollab/credentials-<profile>.json. Leave blank to use the default credentials file.

default_channel.title: Default channel (optional)
default_channel.description: Channel name to auto-subscribe and set as active on startup. Leave blank to auto-subscribe only to #default.

broker_id.title: Broker ID (optional)
broker_id.description: Identifier for the local broker process. Sessions sharing a broker ID share channels, topics, and discovery. Leave blank to use the default shared broker. Set a unique value to run an isolated broker (e.g. 'test' for development).
